headline: Mureșan Says He Would Like to Cut VAT to 19% but Does Not Specify When: 'As Soon as We Can Afford It'
summary: Prime Minister-designate Siegfried Mureșan said his goal is to return VAT to 19% as soon as Romania can afford it, without giving a timeline. He spoke on Monday.
why: VAT is a major consumption tax, and changes to its rate affect government revenue, the budget deficit and household spending.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Mureșan spune că ar vrea să reducă TVA la 19% dar nu precizează de când: „De îndată ce ne permitem acest lucru”
